text: When a customer enters an incorrect password three consecutive times, the login form must be locked for 15 minutes.
The user must be able to log in using a valid registered email address and password.
Upon successful login, the system shall generate a secure JWT access token valid for 24 hours.
If an account session remains inactive for 30 minutes, the user must be automatically logged out.
The application must support multi-factor authentication (MFA) via TOTP authenticator app.
Password reset requests must send a single-use time-limited token expiring after 15 minutes.
Users must be redirected to the login page when attempting to access authenticated endpoints without a token.
The system shall invalidate existing refresh tokens when the user clicks log out.
Password changes must require the user to re-enter their current password for re-authentication.
Failed login attempts must be tracked with timestamp and IP address to mitigate brute-force attacks.
When logging out on one device, the user should be prompted if they want to terminate all active sessions.
Social single-sign-on (SSO) via Google OAuth2 must map to the user's primary corporate email.
The login screen must remember the username when the 'Remember Me' checkbox is checked.
Temporary passwords issued by support must be forced to change on first login.
The user account must be unlocked automatically after the 15-minute lockout period expires.
OAuth state parameters must be validated to prevent CSRF login attacks.
Session cookies must have HttpOnly, Secure, and SameSite=Strict attributes set.
The application must display a warning when logging in from an unrecognized new device.
The password field must require at least 8 characters, one uppercase letter, one digit, and one special character.
Email address inputs must match standard RFC 5322 format and reject spaces or invalid domain extensions.
The telephone number input must accept 10 digits and reject alphabetical characters.
Zip code input must accept 5 numeric digits or 9 digits with standard hyphen format.
The birth date input cannot be set to a future date.
The file upload field must only allow PDF, PNG, and JPEG files under 10 megabytes.
Required form fields must display an inline red error message when submitted empty.
Credit card CVV input must be restricted to 3 or 4 numeric digits.
The order quantity must be an integer between 1 and 99 items.
Username must contain between 3 and 20 alphanumeric characters without spaces.
Text input fields must reject HTML tags and script injection characters.
The discount coupon code must be alphanumeric and between 4 and 12 characters.
Currency fields must accept non-negative decimal numbers with at most two decimal places.
The customer shipping address must include street, city, state, and postal code.
The URL input field must be a valid HTTP or HTTPS URI.
Textarea comments must not exceed a maximum length of 500 characters.
IP address fields must conform to valid IPv4 or IPv6 notation.
Percentage discount fields must validate values between 0.01 and 100.00 percent.
When an order total exceeds $100, the system must apply free standard shipping at checkout.
If an item is out of stock in inventory, the 'Add to Cart' button must be disabled.
Orders placed before 2 PM local time must qualify for same-day delivery dispatch.
When a customer cancels an unpaid order, reserved inventory must be returned to stock within 5 minutes.
VIP loyalty members must receive an automatic 10% discount on all eligible catalog items.
If an order payment status transitions to 'settled', the warehouse fulfillment status must be set to 'processing'.
Applying a percentage promo code must recalculate sales tax based on the discounted subtotal.
When a subscription renewal fails on the due date, a 3-day grace period must be initiated.
Purchasing a gift card must generate an encrypted 16-digit redemption code sent via email.
The shopping cart subtotal must dynamically update when item quantities are changed.
Refund amounts cannot exceed the original settled charge of the order.
When loyalty points are redeemed at checkout, each 100 points must reduce the order balance by $1.00.
Split shipping must create separate shipment tracking numbers for each fulfillment warehouse.
Customers with abandoned carts for 24 hours should be queued for a reminder notification.
Backordered items must be marked clearly with an estimated restock date.
The checkout flow must preserve selected shipping options when moving back to edit cart items.
Multi-item bundles must deduct stock inventory from each individual component SKU.
Trial period accounts must transition to read-only status after 14 days unless upgraded.
Only users with the 'admin' role can delete user accounts or alter global system configuration.
Regular members must not be able to access or modify project settings of other organizations.
All sensitive customer PII including tax IDs and card numbers must be encrypted at rest with AES-256.
Every administrative action including privilege changes must be recorded in an immutable audit log.
All external HTTP traffic must be redirected to HTTPS using TLS 1.3 encryption.
API requests must enforce rate limits of 100 calls per minute per IP address.
Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) payloads in user input must be sanitized before rendering.
The application must block requests targeting private loopback or internal cloud metadata addresses.
API endpoints must reject requests lacking valid authorization headers with 401 Unauthorized.
Direct object references in URLs (IDOR) must be checked against tenant ownership permissions.
Database connection credentials and API keys must be loaded from secure vault secrets.
User passwords must be hashed using bcrypt or Argon2 with high work factors.
CORS headers must be strictly restricted to approved frontend domain origins.
File uploads must be scanned for malicious binary executables and virus signatures.
Users with 'viewer' role must receive 403 Forbidden when attempting POST or PUT modifications.
Session identifiers must be cryptographically random and regenerated upon privilege escalation.
Server error responses must never expose stack traces, database schema, or internal paths.
Customer credit card numbers must never be logged in application or web server logs.
When the payment gateway is unreachable, the checkout must display a retry banner without losing cart data.
If an internal server exception occurs, the API must return a structured 500 JSON error envelope.
When a requested requirement or project does not exist, the API must return 404 Not Found.
Network timeouts during third-party address verification must fall back to manual address entry.
If database connection is lost, incoming write requests must fail with a 503 Service Unavailable.
When the user uploads a corrupted image file, the UI must show an error dialog and allow re-upload.
API rate limit breaches must return HTTP 429 Too Many Requests with a Retry-After header.
Submitting expired session tokens must prompt the user with a session expired dialog.
When an invalid JSON body is posted, the API must respond with 400 Bad Request and validation details.
If the AI microservice fails to process a request, the platform must degrade gracefully to draft status.
Network disconnection during file download must offer an automatic resume option.
When external webhook delivery fails, the dispatcher must retry with exponential backoff up to 5 times.
Payment authorization decline codes must be translated into user-friendly guidance messages.
If email delivery fails due to SMTP timeout, the job must be re-queued in the dead-letter queue.
When a concurrency version conflict is detected, the API must return a 409 Conflict status.
The frontend must display a global error boundary fallback if an unhandled React render error occurs.
Client requests exceeding 10MB payload size must be rejected with 413 Payload Too Large.
Failed background batch jobs must send an alert to the operations Slack channel.
Every project must enforce unique requirement titles within that project scope.
Deleting a parent project must cascade delete or archive all associated requirements and test cases.
Database write transactions for multi-step order checkout must roll back completely if payment fails.
Concurrent edits to a test case version must be protected by optimistic concurrency controls.
Database records must maintain updated_at timestamps on every update operation.
User email addresses must be stored in lowercase and enforced by a unique database index.
Soft-deleted records must be filtered out from standard queries while preserving foreign keys.
Execution run records must link to exact immutable test case versions to guarantee auditability.
Database backups must run automatically every 24 hours with checksum integrity verification.
Data migrations must be idempotent and support backwards rollback without data corruption.
Historical versions of requirements must be immutable once new versions are created.
Financial ledger entries must be append-only with no destructive update operations permitted.
Deduplication logic must prevent identical webhook events from being processed more than once.
Customer cart data must persist reliably across browser refreshes and session restarts.
Foreign key references to deleted organizations must be rejected by database constraints.
Database write operations must use strict schema validation to prevent unmodeled properties.
Batch import operations must validate all rows and abort the batch if more than 5% fail validation.
Event streams must guarantee at-least-once delivery with consumer deduplication keys.
